forum.title: SOLDERING REFLOW TEMP. FOR TS555IDTTR
forum.best_answer_content:
STMicroelectronics fully complies with JEDEC, which specifies the soldering profile in standard J-STD-020, currently revision F, that you can [download here](https://www.jedec.org/standards-documents/docs/j-std-020e).

The peak temperature Tc can be found in the device’s Material Declaration (product website, tab [Quality & Reliability](https://www.st.com/en/clocks-and-timers/ts555.html#quality-reliability)). For the SO-8 of the [TS555IDTTR](https://www.st.com/en/clocks-and-timers/ts555.html), Tc = 260°C.

Hope that helps?

Regards

/Peter
